name: main-menu-visual
description: Visual verification of the main menu: title and subtitle display, menu buttons (New Campaign, Tutorial, Continue, Load, Settings) as they first render before any game state exists, the New Campaign -> world map flow with three campaign level cards (Dusty Hollow, Grumpstone Ridge, Treranium Depths) showing lock/unlock status and completion stars, the Back button returning to the main menu, and then the in-game HUD after a level is started.

steps.description: Initial load: page has not run any command yet, so the main menu overlay (title, subtitle, and all 5 buttons) is the only thing on screen. 'help' is a read-only console command that does not touch game state or the DOM, used here purely so the step has a harmless command to pair with the screenshot.

expect.note: no game state exists yet, so only usable/blocked (DOM-only, interaction mode) can check anything here -- confirms the New Campaign button genuinely renders before any command runs

steps.description: Click New Campaign: reveals the world map with 3 level cards. Dusty Hollow (tier 1) is unlocked with a Start button; Grumpstone Ridge and Treranium Depths are locked, showing the lock icon and the profit threshold required on the prior level. No game exists yet, so 'state' is the paired command (it fails gracefully with 'No game loaded' — this step is UI-only, the command exists only to satisfy the command/interaction pairing convention).

expect.note: the world map genuinely replaced the main menu -- Back is now reachable, New Campaign is not

steps.description: Click Back on the world map: returns to the main menu button list, confirming the round trip does not leave stray DOM behind.

expect.note: the round trip genuinely returns to the main menu, not a leftover world map still in the DOM
confirmed via direct trace: cash stays flat with no employees/buildings/vehicles to drain it

steps.description: Resolved through the event dialog's own buttons. Decides whether an event is pending from authoritative game state, not from whether the modal has rendered -- a DOM-only probe silently missed events on a no-GPU runner where a frame costs ~6s, leaving them pending so later ticks halted and the run diverged while still passing command mode.
